title: 按任务业务语义生成停机后的恢复计划
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 给出题设要求的具体交付物与关键机制
用可观察结果验证约束和失败分支
明确停止条件及回退或恢复边界
body:
## 操作任务
实现recover_plan(state)。对backfill任务逐期处理未完成周期；complete跳过，unknown只能进入人工核对，missing才安排运行。latest_only任务只运行最新到期周期，旧周期标记为superseded。输出稳定排序且使用job:period作为幂等键；未知policy必须拒绝。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
使用纯Python合同覆盖结算补跑、刷新跳过、未知结果隔离、幂等键和计划确定性。

## 能力边界
计划按任务类型显式区分逐期补齐与只保留最新周期，并把结果不明项隔离到核对队列；这是计划生成，不会实际执行结算或刷新，也不能代替执行端对(job,period)幂等键的唯一约束和互斥锁。

conversion.original_title: 设计宿主机重启后批任务恢复方案，要求明确漏跑、补跑和重叠运行各自的业务语义。

exercise.environment: 非root Linux，现有本地原生工具，自有短生命周期资源
exercise.operation: 实现recover_plan(state)。对backfill任务逐期处理未完成周期；complete跳过，unknown只能进入人工核对，missing才安排运行。latest_only任务只运行最新到期周期，旧周期标记为superseded。输出稳定排序且使用job:period作为幂等键；未知policy必须拒绝。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import importlib.util,json,pathlib,sys,tempfile
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: scheduled recovery planner',flush=True)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',pathlib.Path('task.py'))
task=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(task)
periods=["2026-10-23","2026-10-24","2026-10-25","2026-10-26"]
state={"jobs":[
 {"name":"settlement","policy":"backfill","due":periods,"status":{"2026-10-24":"complete","2026-10-25":"unknown"}},
 {"name":"cache-refresh","policy":"latest_only","due":periods,"status":{"2026-10-24":"missing","2026-10-25":"missing","2026-10-26":"missing"}},
]}
print('NATIVE_OPERATION_ENTERED:recover_plan',flush=True)
plan=task.recover_plan(state)
assert plan["run"]==[
 {"key":"settlement:2026-10-23","job":"settlement","period":"2026-10-23"},
 {"key":"cache-refresh:2026-10-26","job":"cache-refresh","period":"2026-10-26"},
 {"key":"settlement:2026-10-26","job":"settlement","period":"2026-10-26"}],plan
assert plan["reconcile"]==[{"key":"settlement:2026-10-25","reason":"unknown_result"}],plan
assert {x["key"] for x in plan["skipped"]}=={"settlement:2026-10-24","cache-refresh:2026-10-23","cache-refresh:2026-10-24","cache-refresh:2026-10-25"},plan
assert task.recover_plan(state)==plan,'recovery plan must be deterministic for an unchanged ledger'
try:task.recover_plan({"jobs":[{"name":"bad","policy":"guess","due":[]}]})
except ValueError:pass
else:raise AssertionError('unknown policy must fail closed')

print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
